items.title: Bat on a Star Cushion
items.alt: A round little bat rests on a mustard star-shaped cushion, wings wrapped and ears perked up, no other stars.
items.description: A round little bat rests on a mustard star-shaped cushion, wings wrapped and ears perked up, no other stars. Useful for personal bedtime decorations.

items.title: Bat Listening Beside a Shell
items.alt: A curious bat perches on a short piece of driftwood, one large spiral shell beside its head, oversized ears tilted toward it.
items.description: A curious bat perches on a short piece of driftwood, one large spiral shell beside its head, oversized ears tilted toward it. Useful for imaginative listening prompts.

items.title: Bat beside a Leaf Kite
items.alt: A fantasy bat sits on a stump and grips a kite reel with its hind feet while one small leaf-shaped kite floats beside it on a continuous string.
items.description: A fantasy bat sits on a stump and grips a kite reel with its hind feet while one small leaf-shaped kite floats beside it on a continuous string. Useful for outdoor story prompts.
